Subject: Nimble Financial: technical workshop — proposed times & attendee list

Hi Sanjay / Lisa,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the context on your latency constraints and the ingestion patterns for transactions. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock in the technical workshop (architecture + integration patterns):

Summary (short)
- Primary goals: validate inference latency at peak load, review secure data paths, and confirm model selection for the fraud-detection workflow.
- Key constraints: avg. 1.2s token latency SLO, 10k requests/hour burst, on-prem audit requirements.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute technical workshop where our Solutions Eng (Aditya) will walk your infra team through integration options and the Dedicated/private deployment tradeoffs.

Available slots (PST) next week — pick one that works for your team:
- Tue Dec 1, 11:00–12:30
- Wed Dec 2, 09:00–10:30
- Thu Dec 3, 14:00–15:30

Please confirm: 1) preferred slot, 2) desired call platform (Zoom or Google Meet), and 3) attendee list (names + roles). I can send a calendar invite with the Zoom link once we lock time.

Draft agenda (short)
- 5 min: introductions & goals
- 20 min: architecture review and data flow considerations
- 20 min: model variants, quantization, and expected throughput/cost
- 15 min: integration patterns and infra checklist
- 10 min: next steps and action items

Attaching a one-page discovery recap from today's call for reference.

[Attachment: nimble_discovery_notes.pdf (PDF, 85KB)]

Thanks — looking forward to narrowing this down.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales
